programme.title: A Sky Full of Stars for a Roof
programme.desc: Two drifters meet and soon become travelling companions. But one of them, Tim (Gemma), is being chased by a crazed killer and his band of gunmen to settle an old score. programme.title: Wax: We Are The X
programme.desc: Gripping road movie, starring Rutger Hauer and Andrea Sartoretti. The trip will turn into an unpredictable and daring adventure, a symbol of an entire generation's desire for redemption.

programme.title: Scalps

programme.title: La figlia di Lady Chatterly

programme.title: So Young, So Lovely, So Vicious...
programme.desc: Gloria Guida is the cheeky teenager Angela, daughter of the widower Dr. Batrucchi. When she meets her father's new companion, Irene, taken in dislike she attempts by various subterfuges to discredit her in the man's eyes. programme.title: Who Finds a Friend Finds a Treasure
programme.desc: Alan, a gambler, drains his uncle's savings and takes refuge on Charlie's boat, on a cruise. programme.title: Getaway of Love
